text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a research article, not a review. While it uses land use/land cover (LULC) data to detect past ecological restoration project sites (2000–2020), it does not include any LULC prediction or future simulation component. The study focuses on classifying ecological performance regimes based on planetary boundaries, quantifying ecosystem services (biodiversity, water yield, carbon sequestration), and optimizing spatial priorities for ecological restoration under multiple scenarios—but all scenarios are based on current or historical land cover, not projected future LULC changes. It fails the core inclusion criterion of implementing ≥2 future LULC scenarios with quantitative comparison and lacks mapped LULC projections. The absence of any predictive LULC modeling excludes it under the specific exclusion criterion “No LULC prediction component.”)
